name: folder-reveal
title: Folder Reveal
description: A folder that fans its cards out when opened: the flap tips forward and the cards rise and spread, on hover, click or keyboard.

props.name: items
props.description: Cards kept in the folder. Five or fewer read best.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the folder button.

props.name: trigger
props.description: hover opens under a mouse; both triggers toggle on click and keyboard.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new open state.

props.name: size
props.description: Folder width in pixels. Height follows.

props.name: spread
props.description: Horizontal distance in pixels between fanned cards.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Degrees of rotation per card as the fan opens.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the folder button.
